en: A vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard view of an old courtyard in Tangier with whitewashed buildings featuring Moorish arches and a small exterior staircase. A tall minaret-like tower rises in the background. Printed French text at the top identifies the scene as the Palace of Justice and the Treasury in Tangier. Additional small-print text with the collection and photographer appears at the bottom right.
